title: IME and CJK input in Slint
setup: Settings > Time & language > Language & region: add Japanese (Microsoft IME), Chinese (Simplified, PRC) (Microsoft Pinyin) and Korean (Microsoft IME). Switch between them with Win+Space.
Keep the wizard open. It captures the test app's console output automatically (press l during a test to view it).

tests.title: Japanese: inline composition in LineEdit
tests.do: Switch to JA. Click LineEdit (1). Type nihongo. Press Space. Press Enter.
tests.expect: While typing, the kana appears INLINE in the field, highlighted, with no floating IME box. After Space: the kanji. After Enter: committed. Log: exactly one 'edited' event. NO 'accepted', NO 'key-pressed <Return>'. Latin is in Plex, kanji in Yu Gothic UI.

tests.title: Japanese: candidate list position
tests.do: JA. Type kanji, press Space (candidate list opens), Space again.
tests.expect: The candidate list is directly BELOW THE START of the composition in the LineEdit (not at the window corner, not at screen 0,0). Arrow Down moves within the list.

tests.title: Chinese Pinyin
tests.do: Switch to ZH Pinyin. In LineEdit (1) type zhongwen, then press 1 or Space.
tests.expect: Inline pinyin (zhong'wen) while typing; candidate bar under the field; the Chinese text is committed; one 'edited' event.

tests.title: Korean Hangul
tests.do: Switch to KO (2-set). In LineEdit (1) type: gksrmf dlqfur
tests.expect: Hangul input with the space in the right place. Each syllable shows inline while being composed. No doubled or reordered jamo.

tests.title: Korean: caret movement commits first
tests.do: KO. Type gks (a syllable is composing), then press Left.
tests.expect: The syllable is committed first, THEN the caret moves left of it.

tests.title: Japanese: long sentence and clauses
tests.do: JA. Type watashihanihongonobenkyouwoshiteimasu, Space, then Left/Right, Space, Enter.
tests.expect: Inline composition grows. After conversion Left/Right switch the active clause (caret jumps between clauses; candidate list re-targets). Note how readable it is: whole composition highlighted, no underline. Enter commits the sentence.

tests.title: Arrow keys during composition
tests.do: JA/ZH. While composing, press Left/Right/Home/End.
tests.expect: Slint's caret does not move and the log shows NO 'key-pressed'. After commit, arrows move the caret normally and are logged.

tests.title: Narrow field: end of long composition
tests.do: In the narrow LineEdit type aaaaaaaa, then a long JA composition (toukyoutokkyokyokakyoku) at the end.
tests.expect: Record: is the end of the composition visible before commit? (Expected: it is clipped at the right edge until commit, then the field scrolls.)

tests.title: Wrapped TextEdit
tests.do: In TextEdit (2) click at the end of the first wrapped line, type nihongonihongo, Space.
tests.expect: The composition wraps to the next line correctly. Record where the candidate list appears and whether it covers the composition.

tests.title: Custom Plex TextInput
tests.do: In PlexInput (3) repeat tests 1, 3 and 4.
tests.expect: Same as 1, 3, 4. The red line below shows the raw composition while composing and is empty after commit. Latin in Plex, kana/kanji in Yu Gothic UI, hanzi in YaHei UI, Hangul in Malgun Gothic.

tests.title: Esc and Backspace during composition
tests.do: JA: type nihongo, press Esc. Then type nihongo, Backspace twice, Enter.
tests.expect: Esc: composition disappears, field unchanged, and an Esc is NOT logged. Backspace edits only the composition; the commit inserts the shortened text.

tests.title: Click elsewhere mid-composition (other field)
tests.do: JA: type nihongo (do not commit), click PlexInput.
tests.expect: Record one of: committed into LineEdit / committed into PlexInput / dropped. Any is acceptable if consistent; text must not be duplicated.

tests.title: Click elsewhere mid-composition (same field)
tests.do: JA: in PlexInput type nihongo, click elsewhere in the same text.
tests.expect: Record: the composition moves with the caret (known caveat), commits, or is dropped. Nothing may be duplicated or corrupted.

tests.title: Alt+Tab mid-composition (known bug #10861)
tests.do: KO and JA: type gks / nihongo, Alt+Tab to another app and back.
tests.expect: Known bug: the composing text is lost. Record the actual behaviour.

tests.title: Switching IME does not freeze the UI (#5206)
tests.do: With the app focused and the IME set to English, press Win+Space to Microsoft Pinyin, then type. Repeat on Windows 10 if available.
tests.expect: The heartbeat in the top line keeps counting and input appears. If the heartbeat STOPS, note the renderer and OS build and retry test 17's software renderer.

tests.title: CJK font order: --cjk ja
tests.do: Compare row 'default stack' with the 'Yu Gothic UI' and 'Microsoft YaHei UI' rows. Look at the characters for straight, bone, corner, now, sea.
tests.expect: Han glyphs in the default row match the Yu Gothic row. Kana always Yu Gothic, Hangul always Malgun. The 'no glyph' row is blank or a box, no crash.

tests.title: CJK font order: --cjk zh
tests.do: Same comparison as before.
tests.expect: Han glyphs in the default row match the YaHei row.

tests.title: CJK font order: --cjk system (baseline)
tests.do: Same comparison as before.
tests.expect: Record which font DirectWrite picked (Yu Gothic-like or YaHei-like).

tests.title: Software renderer gives identical behaviour
tests.do: Repeat tests 1, 3 and 4 with the software renderer.
tests.expect: Identical behaviour and look to the default renderer.

tests.title: Display scaling 150% (and a second monitor)
tests.do: Set display scaling to 150% (and use a second monitor with different scaling if available). Repeat tests 1 to 3 with the window on each monitor.
tests.expect: Candidate list still directly under the composition; no offset that grows with the scale factor.
